input.answer: Looks cheap to me: 0.07% for each buy or sell (at least 2 ₪), 0.03% a quarter to hold the stuff, 0 ₪ a month for the account, and I need at least 10,000 ₪ to open one, so my 30,000 is enough. I can buy קרן סל and קרנות נאמנות there, but foreign shares say "לא ידוע", and the currency fee is confusing: it says 1.5 agorot per dollar and also 0.5%.

stuck.where: המרת מטבע, screen 1 bottom and screen 2 top
stuck.why: There are two currency fees one after the other, "1.5 אגורות לדולר" and then "0.5%". I don't know if that's two different charges or one of them is wrong, and for buying the S&P in dollars that's the one that matters.

The ad says no currency conversion fee and no fee on קרנות כספיות, but the orange tag "המסמך אומר אחרת" says the real paper charges. So which one do I get? I went with the paper, 0.07% and 1.5 agorot.
The page jumps. The דמי משמרת box starts at the bottom of screen 2 and I never really saw what was in it.
